info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Airline Flights Seatmaps-v2-spec
info.description: The Airline Flights Seatmap API provides access to detailed seating arrangements for airline flights. It enables users to view and analyze available seatmaps for specific flights, facilitating informed travel decisions. This API is typically utilized by travel agencies, flight booking platforms, and airline customers seeking to select their preferred seating options. With this endpoint, developers can integrate seatmap information into their applications, enhancing the user experience for travelers.

get.summary: Retrieve seat map for a specific flight.
get.description: This endpoint retrieves the seat map for a specified flight, allowing users to see the available seats, their status, and seat types. Ideal for checking seating arrangements before booking.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the seat map information for a specific flight. It must contain all necessary parameters required for obtaining the seat map details.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the seatmap for the requested flight.
